answer: The pigment report reveals the merge explicitly at each pulse. Each collapsed cluster gets one relic weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The replay builds a funding-and-timing graph over every join and collapses clusters that share a funder, an address prefix, or suspiciously correlated submission times into a single entity. A 430 account operation therefore ties up 34 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
